basedOn.note: Current device screenshot confirms the new offline center renders correctly, lists completed tasks and shows the cached save directory. The screenshot also exposes UX noise: an overlong input placeholder, technical CID/mode text and raw info_hash values dominate the page. Test14 is UI-only cleanup on top of that working structure.

shorten the page/entry title from 离线下载中心（新版） to 离线中心
